executive_summary: Recorded closure for frontier-42-coxeter-32 is complete: 304 items in coxeter-groups (60 pages) and hopf-hecke-algebras (4 pages) carry complete judge verdicts, both proof-layout gates pass over the 2,062 recorded proof steps, all 278 recorded fatal rows are closed as fixed, all 37 judge rejections were adjudicated (14 confirmed fatal, 17 confirmed nonfatal, 6 false positives), and no workflow-owned blockers, deferrals, or terminal resolutions remain. The verdict is publishable-pending-owner-approval, with three owner actions outstanding: personal mathematical audit, deliberate status:published changes, and push/deployment. My interpretation: the evidence chain is internally complete, and the residual risk concentrates in items with confirmed-fatal, multi-round, or superseded defect histories, which drive the reading list below. I did not re-read the items or their sources, so this report interprets the recorded closure rather than independently confirming the mathematics.
caveats: Interpretive scope: I read only the step-9 evidence packet plus the named pathway-closure artifact, so no statement, proof, or citation of any item is independently confirmed here; the owner's personal mathematical audit remains the only human reading step before publication.

Disposition semantics: all 278 fatal rows are marked fixed (261 outright and 17 historical b22/b30 rows superseded by named successor entries), but these are the run's own recorded resolutions; judge coverage is stated in aggregate (339 complete versions), so this report cannot map individual repairs to per-repair re-judgments.

Judge coverage: the resolved configured judge set provided a single model's coverage on the frozen context, with 339 complete versions carrying exact verdicts (302 kept, 37 rejected, none null or mixed); all 37 rejections were adjudicated, and 6 were adjudicated as false positives, so rejection signals are not uniformly defects and no multi-model agreement evidence exists in this packet.

Hash binding: the verdict, proof-layout gates, and judge evidence apply to recorded content revision 6c7c979ddeee... and its protected prerequisite-context tree; any edit after this clearance invalidates the evidence, and a different revision must not inherit it.
